name: factory
description: An orchestrator skill that drives a pipeline of typed phases declared in .factory/config.yaml (the built-in scope, scope-review, build, and ship when there is none), running the interactive phases inline and the rest unattended, judging each phase's completion itself and repairing or relaunching it on failure, ending in a pull request or a report. Use on Claude Code or Codex when you want a request carried through to a shipped change without a human at each phase.

interface.shortDescription: Drive a declared pipeline of phases unattended.
